deviations.claim_in_article: Passengers who saw LOWER suggested tip rates left more money than those who saw higher suggested rates, according to the New York City taxi study.
deviations.issue: The article reverses the reported comparison: the ledger says passengers who saw higher suggested tip rates tipped more.
deviations.explanation: F-004 reports more tipping after exposure to higher recommended rates; the article states the opposite. The comparison is reversed, making the factual claim inconsistent with the ledger.
